# dialog/Close.spec.mjs reds every unit run: its teardown removes a stub a dialog still calls

Owned: urgent, every pull request based on `dev` since `f04f579a5f` (#21433) fails its `unit` job on this spec.

## Context

`test/playwright/unit/dialog/Close.spec.mjs:181` ("a dialog that mounts syncs the mask below itself once it is on the page") fails 3 of 3 attempts in CI on #21458 (run 44504968979, job 135494852616: 1 failed, 8109 passed) and #21450, and on the outside PR #21405; #21409, whose base predates `f04f579a5f`, is green. Locally on `dev` it fails every run:

```
TypeError: Neo.main.DomAccess.syncModalMask is not a function
    at forEach (test/playwright/unit/dialog/Close.spec.mjs:67:73)
```

## The Problem

Line 67 is the `afterEach` that destroys the test's dialogs. Two lines earlier the same hook restores the `DomAccess` stubs, deleting `syncModalMask`, which the unit environment does not own. #21433 made `Neo.dialog.Base#destroy()` sync a mounted modal dialog's mask away (`me.mounted && me.modal && me.syncModalMask(me.id, false)`, `src/dialog/Base.mjs:595`), and the test at `:181` ends with its dialog mounted, so its teardown calls the stub after the hook removed it.

## The Architectural Reality

Design authority: n/a — the spec's teardown, not the engine, is wrong: `destroy()` syncing the mask is #21431's accepted behavior.

## The Fix

The `afterEach` destroys the dialogs first, then restores `Neo.applyDeltas` and the stubs.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] AC-1: `Close.spec.mjs` passes on `dev`, and the `unit` job of a pull request based on the fix no longer fails on it.

## Out of Scope

- Any change to `Neo.dialog.Base`.
